annotations.title: Check if a website is down

description: Check if a website is up or down right now. Use it when someone asks whether a site is down, or if it is just them. Makes one request to the site and returns a verdict sentence, the status (UP, DOWN or NOT CHECKABLE), the HTTP code, the time taken, and the real place the check ran from. The check runs near the machine that calls this tool, which may not be near the end user. The site's content is never read.

url.description: The domain or full URL to check, for example example.com or https://example.com/status. A bare domain is tried over https first.

name: check_site

checkedFrom.description: The real place the check ran from: a city, a raw location code when the city is not known, or "Location unavailable". Never guessed.

finalUrl.description: The last URL requested, after any redirects, or null when no request was sent.

httpCode.description: HTTP status code of the last answer, or null when there was no answer.

latencyMs.description: Time the whole check took, in milliseconds, or null when no request was sent (unsupported port).

redirects.description: Every redirect answer, in order: the URL requested and the 3xx code it answered. Empty when there were no redirects. A redirect the safety rules refused is not listed (reason says it was not followed). URLs longer than 300 characters are cut and end with …

resultUrl.description: HTML page for this target. Opening it runs a new check.

status.description: UP: answered below HTTP 400. DOWN: answered 400 or higher (except 401, 403, 429), or no answer. NOT CHECKABLE: isup cannot reach this port or address (httpCode null), or the site answered 401, 403 or 429 and refuses automated checks; says nothing about whether the site works for people.

target.description: The last URL checked, after any redirects.

verdict.description: The verdict sentence, for example "It's just you. example.com is up."

title: Check if a website is down
